analyst.summary: Tata Teleservices Maharashtra remains in serious financial difficulty, with liabilities that exceed its equity and revenue that continues to shrink in a telecom market dominated by much larger rivals. The company is managing a large government dues obligation through installment payments and an equity-conversion arrangement, and may need further support from its parent, Tata Sons. There is no fundamental case for holding this stock; any value in the shares reflects speculation on parent-company or government support rather than the underlying business.
